mapper.sql: LEFT JOIN ( SELECT bike_id, SUM(quantity) AS sold_count, SUM(total_amount) AS sales_amount FROM t_order WHERE deleted = 0 AND status <> '已取消' GROUP BY bike_id ) so ON so.bike_id = b.id
mapper.select:
SELECT b.id, b.name, b.brand, b.category, b.price, b.stock, b.status, b.image_url, b.description, COALESCE(so.sold_count, 0) AS sold_count, COALESCE(so.sales_amount, 0) AS sales_amount FROM t_bike b
ORDER BY b.price ASC ORDER BY b.price DESC ORDER BY b.stock ASC ORDER BY b.stock DESC ORDER BY sold_count DESC ORDER BY b.id DESC

SELECT b.category AS category, COUNT(*) AS bike_count, COALESCE(SUM(b.stock), 0) AS total_stock, ROUND(AVG(b.price), 2) AS avg_price, MAX(b.price) AS max_price, MIN(b.price) AS min_price, COALESCE(SUM(so.sold_count), 0) AS sold_count, COALESCE(SUM(so.sales_amount), 0) AS sales_amount FROM t_bike b
GROUP BY b.category
ORDER BY sold_count DESC ORDER BY max_price DESC ORDER BY min_price ASC ORDER BY bike_count DESC
